installAgentPraw: PRAW: what agents read about HAX
installAgentPrompt: Set up HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) on this computer. Install the HAX CLI with `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`, then install its agent skills with `hax skills install --all`. Make a site with `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`, start it with `cd my-hax-site && hax serve`, and tell me the address it prints. Read the site's AGENTS.md and https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw before you change anything.
